SELECT ID, writer, type, title, content, readcount, timeStamp, hasFile FROM PostIt order by type, ID DESC

SELECT ID, writer, type, title, content, readcount, timeStamp, hasFile FROM PostIt WHERE content like '%${text}%' order by type, ID DESC
